verification_report.summary: Checked all 1 proof items; 1 item(s) failed or were blocked.

critical_errors.location: pi_b03389ef3743055a26090efe, fourth proof, choice of the closed point p
critical_errors.issue: Smoothness does not imply that an arbitrary closed point has separable residue field. For example, over K=F_ℓ((t)), the smooth proper curve P¹_K has the closed point defined by T^ℓ−t, with purely inseparable residue field K(t^(1/ℓ)). Thus the asserted separability of L/K and étaleness of U_L→U do not follow.

gaps.location: pi_b03389ef3743055a26090efe, second proof, endpoint descriptions, fibre classifications, and strict-core formula
gaps.issue: The proof invokes prop:p062-annulus-endpoint-arbitrary-field, prop:p062-arbitrary-field-disc, prop:p062-arbitrary-field-annulus-v4-source-correct, and thm:p062-arbitrary-field-polycylinder-v4-source-correct. None is supplied as a premise or proved in this item. Their asserted verified status cannot establish the endpoint classifications or the essential formula on P^-.

gaps.location: pi_b03389ef3743055a26090efe, second proof, final regularity assertions
gaps.issue: The deduction of weak smoothness and Gubler–Jell–Rabinoff harmonicity invokes unspecified 'already verified comparison results'. No exact statements or authenticated dependencies supporting those comparisons are supplied.

gaps.location: pi_b03389ef3743055a26090efe, third and fourth proofs, fibrewise constancy
gaps.issue: The invoked cor:ch19-continuous-zero-current-harmonic, thm:wanner-curve-comparison, and prop:classical-psh-calculus are absent from the dependency context. The external Wanner theorem compares CLD positivity with Thuillier subharmonicity; the book-local formulation connecting this to classical pluriharmonicity and the required maximum principle is not supplied. See [Wanner, Theorem 4.7 and Corollary 4.8](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1801.04713).

gaps.location: pi_b03389ef3743055a26090efe, third and fourth proofs, descent and gluing of current identities
gaps.issue: Both proofs defer the continuous-multiplier integration identity to the absent prop:p062-open-disc-descent and current gluing to the absent prop:ch14-currents-sheaf. They also omit justification that the normalization ∫_F η=1 persists on F_H(x), which is needed in the displayed product-integral calculation.

gaps.location: pi_b03389ef3743055a26090efe, fourth proof, final transfer assertions
gaps.issue: The applications of prop:ch18-harmonic-functorial and prop:cld-form-pullback rely on undeclared premises. Their exact statements and hypotheses are unavailable, preventing verification of the claimed harmonic and smooth-Hessian transfers as cited.
